001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
013import org.clafer.collection.Triple;
014import org.clafer.common.Util;
015
016/**
017 * Sums a set and |set| &le n. This implementation <b>assumes</b> that the
018 * envelope and kernel are sorted, undefined behaviour otherwise.
019 *
020 * @author jimmy
021 */
022public class PropSetSum extends Propagator<Variable> {
023
024    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
025
026    private final SetVar set;
027    private final IntVar setCard;
028    private final IntVar sum;
029
030    public PropSetSum(SetVar set, IntVar setCard, IntVar sum) {
031        super(new Variable[]{set, setCard, sum}, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
032        this.set = set;
033        this.setCard = setCard;
034        this.sum = sum;
035    }
036
037    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
038        return idx == 0;
039    }
040
041    private boolean isSetCardVar(int idx) {
042        return idx == 1;
043    }
044
045    private boolean isSumVar(int idx) {
046        return idx == 2;
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
051        if (isSetVar(vIdx)) {
052            return SetEventType.all();
053        }
054        assert isSumVar(vIdx) || isSetCardVar(vIdx);
055        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
056    }
057
058    private Triple<int[], int[], int[]> findKerSmallestLargest(int n) {
059        final int[] ker = PropUtil.iterateKer(set);
060        final int[] smallest = new int[n];
061        final int[] largest = new int[n];
062
063        int chooseSize = set.getUB().size() - ker.length;
064        int highStart = chooseSize - n;
065
066        int index = 0;
067        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
068        while(iter.hasNext()) {
069            int i = iter.nextInt();
070            if (!Util.in(i, ker)) {
071                if (index < smallest.length) {
072                    smallest[index] = i;
073                }
074                index++;
075                if (index > highStart) {
076                    largest[chooseSize - index] = i;
077                }
078            }
079        }
080        return new Triple<>(ker, smallest, largest);
081    }
082
083    @Override
084    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
085        boolean changed;
086        do {
087            changed = false;
088            final int envSize = set.getUB().size();
089            final int kerSize = set.getLB().size();
090
091            setCard.updateLowerBound(kerSize, this);
092            setCard.updateUpperBound(envSize, this);
093
094            int lbEnd = setCard.getLB() - kerSize;
095            int ubEnd = setCard.getUB() - kerSize;
096
097            final Triple<int[], int[], int[]> triple = findKerSmallestLargest(ubEnd);
098            int[] ker = triple.getFst();
099            int[] smallest = triple.getSnd();
100            int[] largest = triple.getThd();
101
102            int kerSum = Util.sum(ker);
103            int low = kerSum;
104            int lowEnd;
105            int lowCandidate = 0; // Remove this value when adding another.
106            for (lowEnd = 0; lowEnd < ubEnd; lowEnd++) {
107                int val = smallest[lowEnd];
108                if (!(lowEnd < lbEnd || val < 0)) {
109                    // Still room left. Don't remove lowCandidate if it's negative.
110                    lowCandidate = Math.max(lowCandidate, 0);
111                    break;
112                }
113                lowCandidate = val;
114                low += val;
115            }
116            int high = kerSum;
117            int highStart;
118            int highCandidate = 0; // Remove this value when adding another.
119            for (highStart = 0; highStart < ubEnd; highStart++) {
120                int val = largest[highStart];
121                if (!(highStart < lbEnd || val > 0)) {
122                    // Still room left. Don't remove highCandidate if it's positive.
123                    highCandidate = Math.min(highCandidate, 0);
124                    break;
125                }
126                highCandidate = val;
127                high += val;
128            }
129            highStart = envSize - kerSize - highStart;
130
131            sum.updateLowerBound(low, this);
132            sum.updateUpperBound(high, this);
133
134            int lb = sum.getLB();
135            int ub = sum.getUB();
136
137            int index = 0;
138            ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
139            while(iter.hasNext()) {
140                int i = iter.nextInt();
141                if (!Util.in(i, ker)) {
142                    if (index >= lowEnd) {
143                        int val = low + i - lowCandidate;
144                        // Adding i will never be under the upper bound.
145                        if (val > ub) {
146                            changed |= set.remove(i, this);
147                        }
148                    }
149                    if (index < highStart) {
150                        int val = high + i - highCandidate;
151                        // Adding i will never be over the lower bound.
152                        if (val < lb) {
153                            changed |= set.remove(i, this);
154                        }
155                    }
156                    index++;
157                }
158            }
159        } while (changed);
160    }
161
162    @Override
163    public ESat isEntailed() {
164        int envSize = set.getUB().size();
165        int kerSize = set.getLB().size();
166        if (kerSize > setCard.getUB()) {
167            return ESat.FALSE;
168        }
169        int[] ker = PropUtil.iterateKer(set);
170        int low = 0;
171        int high = 0;
172        // The number of elements seen in env but not in ker.
173        int index = 0;
174        int lowEnd = Math.max(setCard.getLB(), envSize) - kerSize;
175        int highStart = envSize - kerSize - lowEnd;
176        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
177        while(iter.hasNext()) {
178            int i = iter.nextInt();
179            if (Util.in(i, ker)) {
180                low += i;
181                high += i;
182            } else {
183                if (index < lowEnd && i < 0) {
184                    low += i;
185                }
186                if (index >= highStart && i > 0) {
187                    high += i;
188                }
189                index++;
190            }
191        }
192        if (sum.getLB() > high || sum.getUB() < low) {
193            return ESat.FALSE;
194        }
195        return low == high && sum.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
196    }
197
198    @Override
199    public String toString() {
200        return "sum(" + set + ") = " + sum + " where " + setCard;
201    }
202}
